# Monad — Style Reference

> Typewritten field notes on warm linen, one cobalt key. A bookish serif headlines over monospace body copy on #f8f3f1 linen, with 1px graphite ink rules and a single cobalt pill reserved for booking the demo.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Monad uses a typewriter-and-broadsheet product language: a terminal voice for everything functional and a book voice for every claim. The canvas is warm linen #f8f3f1. It steps only to a near-identical #f6f3f1 wash, white #ffffff mockup panels and one periwinkle band at #cfdaf5. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue. Cobalt #2b59d1 fills the single GET A DEMO pill in the nav and nothing else, and the green, salmon and amber gradients stay inside illustrations. Typography carries the hierarchy. ABC Diatype Mono at weight 400 sets 226 of 265 measured text nodes, most of them 18px uppercase labels. Untitled Serif at 400 runs from 24px to 80px with -0.02em tracking on a roughly Perfect Fourth progression. Shape is a two-word vocabulary: 100px pills for anything pressable and 16px corners for cards. Elevation comes from 1px graphite ink borders rather than shadows. The result reads as an engineer's field manual rather than a SaaS landing page.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Linen Canvas | `#f8f3f1` | `--color-linen-canvas` | Body background, nav fill and 14 surface uses, plus 105 text uses as the reversed label on dark pills — a pinkish off-white that makes the serif read as printed matter rather than screen UI. |
| Parchment Wash | `#f6f3f1` | `--color-parchment-wash` | One measured use as an inner panel wash inside the bento grid — a two-point shift from canvas that separates areas without a border. Do not treat it as a distinct elevation step. |
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-white` | Announcement-bar chip, mockup panels inside feature cards and integration logo discs — pure white is reserved for objects that imitate software, never for page surfaces. |
| Frosted Cobalt | `#cfdaf5` | `--color-frosted-cobalt` | Fill of the 40px-radius integrations band, the only tinted section on the page — a pale cobalt tint that lets a whole section carry color without a saturated pixel. |
| Jet Ink | `#000000` | `--color-jet-ink` | H1, h3 card titles, nav anchors and FAQ questions (46 text uses), plus the announcement-bar fill — pure black is the headline ink and sits deliberately darker than the graphite body. |
| Graphite Ink | `#242424` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Dark pill fills (START TRIAL, LOGIN, EXPLORE INTEGRATIONS), section h2s and 1px value-card borders — 66 combined uses make it the workhorse ink and the primary action fill. |
| Graphite Body | `#242424cc` | `--color-graphite-body` | Hero lede, card descriptions and the TRUSTED BY eyebrow at 80% opacity (47 uses) — translucency keeps body text warm on linen instead of switching to a cold gray. |
| Graphite Caption | `#24242499` | `--color-graphite-caption` | Faded integration names, footer meta and tertiary labels at 60% opacity (11 uses) — the third ink step. Do not set running paragraphs in it. |
| Graphite Rule | `#24242433` | `--color-graphite-rule` | 1px borders on bento feature cards, pipeline node tags and FAQ dividers at 20% opacity — a visible rule that still lets the gradient washes show through. |
| Graphite Hairline | `#2424241a` | `--color-graphite-hairline` | 1px outline of the secondary VIEW INTEGRATIONS pill and the pipeline-diagram connector lines at 10% — the faintest line in the system, used where a full rule would be noise. |
| Cobalt Signal | `#2b59d1` | `--color-cobalt-signal` | Fill of the GET A DEMO nav pill, a single measured use — the only saturated UI color on the page. Do not spread it to hero buttons, text links or icons. |

## Tokens — Typography

### ABC Diatype Mono — the operating voice: labels, buttons, nav, ledes and FAQ all speak in monospace · `--font-abc-diatype-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 400, IBM Plex Mono at 400, JetBrains Mono at 350. Diatype Mono draws light for its nominal 400, with thin, even strokes. JetBrains Mono at 400 reads bolder, so drop it to 350 to match the stroke.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 20px
- **Line height:** 1.2 (12px and 18px, set to `normal`), 1.3 (16px tracked labels), 1.35 (14px, 16px, 20px reading text)
- **Letter spacing:** -0.4px at 12px, -0.28px at 14px, +0.8px at 16px uppercase labels, -0.4px at 16px body, -0.4px at 18px, -0.4px at 20px
- **Role:** Monospace as the default body face is the signature and anti-convention for a B2B landing page. Most competitors put mono only in code blocks. Here it makes every sentence read like a log line. Weight 500 appears just 3 times, so emphasis comes from case and tracking: uppercase at +0.8px (0.05em) for navigation and eyebrows, and slightly negative tracking for reading text. The face never bolds its way to attention.

### Untitled Serif — the claim voice: every headline from card title to hero · `--font-untitled-serif`

- **Substitute:** Source Serif 4 at 400 (Display optical size), Newsreader at 400, Literata at 380. Untitled Serif draws true to its weight with moderate contrast. Avoid Playfair or Didone substitutes, because their hairlines read far lighter.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 24px, 32px, 40px, 48px, 80px
- **Line height:** 1.2 at every size
- **Letter spacing:** -0.48px at 24px, -0.64px at 32px, -0.8px at 40px, -0.96px at 48px, -1.6px at 80px (a constant -0.02em)
- **Role:** A single weight across a 24 to 80px range means size alone carries hierarchy. The 80px hero is massive and quiet, never bold. The steps 24 to 32 (1.333) and 32 to 40 (1.25) sit between a Major Third and a Perfect Fourth, then jump 1.667 from 48 to 80 for the hero. That steeper-than-conventional jump isolates the H1 as a book title. Pairing it with mono turns a data-infrastructure pitch into something closer to a technical monograph.

### Untitled Sans — the quiet fallback inside bento feature descriptions · `--font-untitled-sans`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400, Public Sans at 400, Hanken Grotesk at 400. Untitled Sans draws neutral and true to weight, and all three match its stroke at 400.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 16px
- **Line height:** 1.35
- **Letter spacing:** -0.32px at 16px
- **Role:** Only 4 uses, all as 16px descriptions in the How Monad Works bento cards. It intentionally softens dense mockup-adjacent copy where a mono paragraph would compete with the monospace UI inside the screenshots. Treat it as a contained exception rather than a third voice.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | ABC Diatype Mono | 400 | 12px | 1.2 | -0.4px | `--text-small` |
| caption | ABC Diatype Mono | 400 | 16px | 1.3 | 0.8px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | — | 400 | 16px | 1.35 | -0.4px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | ABC Diatype Mono | 400 | 18px | 1.2 | -0.4px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | ABC Diatype Mono | 400 | 20px | 1.35 | -0.4px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Untitled Serif | 400 | 24px | 1.2 | -0.48px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Untitled Serif | 400 | 32px | 1.2 | -0.64px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Untitled Serif | 400 | 40px | 1.2 | -0.8px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Untitled Serif | 400 | 48px | 1.2 | -0.96px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Untitled Serif | 400 | 80px | 1.2 | -1.6px | `--text-display` |

The `body` role is the 18px uppercase label inside every pill button. With 152 uses it is the most frequent text style on the page, which is why it occupies the body slot. Caption and body are both uppercase.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every functional string (nav, buttons, labels, ledes) in ABC Diatype Mono at 400 — monospace body copy is the thesis, and the 226-to-35 mono-to-serif ratio is what makes Monad read as tooling.
- Hold all headlines at Untitled Serif weight 400 with -0.02em tracking (-1.6px at 80px) — hierarchy comes from size steps, not weight.
- Fill primary pills with #242424 and reversed #f8f3f1 labels at 18px uppercase — the dark ink pill is the default action everywhere except the nav demo button.
- Use 100px radius on every pressable element and 16px on every card — the two-value shape vocabulary keeps actions and containers instantly distinguishable.
- Outline content cards with 1px #242424 or 1px #24242433 instead of shadows — ink lines are the elevation system.
- Pad value cards at 40px and separate sections by 100px — the generous rhythm offsets the visual density of monospace text.
- Keep uppercase labels tracked at +0.8px (0.05em) at 16px — positive tracking on caps is the only place letter-spacing opens up, so it marks navigation and eyebrows.

### Don't

- Don't make the hero START TRIAL pill #2b59d1 — cobalt is rationed to one nav button, and repeating it collapses the single-hue budget into conventional SaaS blue.
- Don't bold the serif to 600 or 700 for emphasis — the system's authority comes from 400-weight restraint at 48px and 80px, and heavy headlines read as marketing rather than manual.
- Don't swap the monospace body for a sans at 16px across the page — the mono voice is non-negotiable, and a sans body turns Monad into every other security vendor.
- Don't add drop shadows to value cards — a 10px blur belongs only to #ffffff floating discs and mockups, so card shadows double the elevation language.
- Don't lift section surfaces to #ffffff — pure white is reserved for mockup objects, and a white section breaks the warm #f8f3f1 paper illusion.
- Don't square off buttons to 4px or 8px radius — anything between the 16px card and 100px pill blurs the shape grammar between containers and actions.
- Don't set body paragraphs in #24242499 to look refined — 60% graphite on linen falls to caption contrast and should never carry running text.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f8f3f1 (Linen Canvas)
- headline text: #000000 (Jet Ink)
- body text: #242424cc (Graphite Body)
- muted text: #24242499 (Graphite Caption)
- border: #24242433 (Graphite Rule)
- tinted section: #cfdaf5 (Frosted Cobalt)
- primary action: #242424 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts and graphs use Graphite Rule #24242433 gridlines and Graphite Ink #242424 series strokes. Cobalt #2b59d1 is a solid fill for at most one highlighted series, and Frosted Cobalt #cfdaf5 at 100% serves as the area fill, so data never outshouts the demo button.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor styled as a pill with background #242424, text #f8f3f1, no border, border-radius 100px, padding 10px 30px, height 44px, display inline-flex with center alignment and an 8px gap. Set the label "START TRIAL" in "ABC Diatype Mono" (fallback Geist Mono) at 18px, weight 400, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing -0.4px, text-transform uppercase. Add an optional 10px right chevron in #f8f3f1. No box-shadow. On hover, shift the background to #000000 over 150ms. Place a secondary twin 16px to its right with background #f8f3f1, text #242424 and border 1px solid #2424241a.

2. Build a Navigation Bar: a sticky header on #f8f3f1, max-width 1432px with 40px horizontal padding. Above it, add a 62px full-width announcement strip in #000000 with centered 16px mono text in #f8f3f1. Beside that text, add a #ffffff chip with radius 2000px, padding 6px 12px and #000000 12px uppercase text. In the main row, set links with padding 50px 0, giving a 122px row height. Place a 144px logo left, then links PLATFORM, SOLUTIONS, INTEGRATIONS, RESOURCES and ABOUT US at 32px gaps in "ABC Diatype Mono" 16px weight 400 uppercase, tracking 0.8px, color #000000. On the right, put a #242424 LOGIN pill and a #2b59d1 GET A DEMO pill, each radius 100px, height 44px, padding 10px 30px, 18px uppercase #f8f3f1 labels, with a 16px gap between them.

3. Build a Value Card: a 666 × 308px block, background #f8f3f1, border 1px solid #242424, border-radius 16px, padding 40px, no shadow, with a decorative radial gradient bleeding from the top-left corner at low opacity. Stack a 32px outline icon in #242424, a 24px gap, a title in "Untitled Serif" (fallback Source Serif 4) at 32px weight 400, line-height 1.2, letter-spacing -0.64px, color #000000, a 16px gap, then body text in "ABC Diatype Mono" 20px weight 400, line-height 1.35, letter-spacing -0.4px, color #242424cc. Lay two cards side by side with a 20px gap.

4. Build an Integration Band: a section with background #cfdaf5, border-radius 40px, padding 40px, full container width 1432px, no border, no shadow. The left column, max 559px, holds an "Untitled Serif" heading at 40px weight 400, letter-spacing -0.8px, color #242424, a 24px gap, mono body at 20px in #242424cc, a 32px gap, and a #242424 pill with radius 100px, padding 10px 30px and an 18px uppercase #f8f3f1 label. The right column holds a vertical list of rows. Each row has a 64px #ffffff disc (radius 50%, shadow rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 0px 10px 0px) containing a logo, followed by a name in Untitled Serif at 32px in #24242499, rows spaced 30px apart, with 1px #2424241a chevron strokes behind.

### Pill Button — Outline (Secondary)

**Role:** Lower-commitment alternate action

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every functional string (nav, buttons, labels, ledes) in ABC Diatype Mono at 400 — monospace body copy is the thesis, and the 226-to-35 mono-to-serif ratio is what makes Monad read as tooling.
- Hold all headlines at Untitled Serif weight 400 with -0.02em tracking (-1.6px at 80px) — hierarchy comes from size steps, not weight.
- Fill primary pills with #242424 and reversed #f8f3f1 labels at 18px uppercase — the dark ink pill is the default action everywhere except the nav demo button.
- Use 100px radius on every pressable element and 16px on every card — the two-value shape vocabulary keeps actions and containers instantly distinguishable.
- Outline content cards with 1px #242424 or 1px #24242433 instead of shadows — ink lines are the elevation system.
- Pad value cards at 40px and separate sections by 100px — the generous rhythm offsets the visual density of monospace text.
- Keep uppercase labels tracked at +0.8px (0.05em) at 16px — positive tracking on caps is the only place letter-spacing opens up, so it marks navigation and eyebrows.

### Don't

- Don't make the hero START TRIAL pill #2b59d1 — cobalt is rationed to one nav button, and repeating it collapses the single-hue budget into conventional SaaS blue.
- Don't bold the serif to 600 or 700 for emphasis — the system's authority comes from 400-weight restraint at 48px and 80px, and heavy headlines read as marketing rather than manual.
- Don't swap the monospace body for a sans at 16px across the page — the mono voice is non-negotiable, and a sans body turns Monad into every other security vendor.
- Don't add drop shadows to value cards — a 10px blur belongs only to #ffffff floating discs and mockups, so card shadows double the elevation language.
- Don't lift section surfaces to #ffffff — pure white is reserved for mockup objects, and a white section breaks the warm #f8f3f1 paper illusion.
- Don't square off buttons to 4px or 8px radius — anything between the 16px card and 100px pill blurs the shape grammar between containers and actions.
- Don't set body paragraphs in #24242499 to look refined — 60% graphite on linen falls to caption contrast and should never carry running text.

## Elevation

- **Integration logo discs and floating product mockups (12 uses):** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 0px 10px 0px`
- **Cards, buttons, nav and sections:** `none` — elevation is carried by 1px borders in #242424 (value cards) or #24242433 (bento tiles), so the zero-offset 10px halo signals "screenshot of software" rather than "raised UI".

There is no photography. Imagery is product schematic and abstracted UI. The hero is a node diagram: outlined pill tags on hairline #2424241a curves converge on a diamond hub of four soft tiles (INGEST, REDUCE, ROUTE, NORMALIZE) around the nine-dot logo mark. A green radial glow sits behind the hub, and it is decorative, not a system token. Content sits in a 1432px container with 40px gutters, giving a 1352px measure. The hero centers an 80px serif H1 capped at 800px, a 559px mono lede and two pills, then a full-width pipeline diagram. Logos run as a six-up marquee. ## Monospace Discipline

The defining move is that monospace is the reading face, not the code face. ABC Diatype Mono at weight 400 sets 226 measured nodes, including the 20px hero lede, every 18px pill label and every FAQ question. Untitled Serif is reserved for the 35 headline nodes. Three things break this. One is promoting a sans to body text, since Untitled Sans exists only in 4 bento descriptions. Another is bolding mono to 500 or above for emphasis outside its 3 measured uses. The third is letting serif creep into labels or buttons. To extend the system, give any new functional element, such as a form input, table cell or toast, ABC Diatype Mono at 16px or 18px with -0.4px tracking. Use uppercase at +0.8px tracking only for navigational labels. Any sentence that makes a claim graduates to Untitled Serif at 24px or larger.

## Single-Hue Rationing

The chromatic budget is one saturated hue in UI: cobalt #2b59d1, measured once, on the GET A DEMO pill. Its pale cousin #cfdaf5 appears only as the integrations band fill. Everything else, from the green hub glow to the salmon and amber washes, is decorative gradient confined to illustrations and card backdrops. The system breaks when cobalt becomes a link color, an icon tint or a second hero CTA, or when a decorative gradient leaks into a button fill or a text color. Extend it by giving status needs, such as the green check badges in mockups, a home inside #ffffff mockup frames only. Ship any new section tint as a pale wash at the #cfdaf5 lightness, never a saturated fill.

## Ink-Line Containment

Containers are drawn, not lifted. Value cards carry 1px #242424 at full strength, bento tiles 1px #24242433, the secondary pill 1px #2424241a and FAQ rows a 20% divider. Three opacity steps of one graphite ink replace the conventional shadow ladder, and the lone 10px halo stays reserved for floating #ffffff mockups. The discipline breaks when a designer stacks a shadow onto a bordered card, introduces a gray hex outside the graphite family, or uses radii between 16px and 100px. Extend it by choosing border strength by meaning: full ink for conclusions and comparisons, 20% for exploratory tiles, and 10% for anything secondary. Pills stay at 100px and containers at 16px. The non-negotiable 40px radius is for whole tinted sections only.

## Similar Brands

- **Anthropic** — Shares the warm off-white canvas and 400-weight serif headlines over restrained graphite text; Monad differs by making monospace, not sans, the body voice.
- **Resend** — Pairs a display serif with monospace technical labels and dark pill CTAs; Resend runs on a black canvas where Monad stays on linen paper.
- **Cribl** — The direct category competitor in security and observability data pipelines with schematic flow diagrams; Cribl leans on saturated brand color where Monad rations one cobalt pill.
- **Tines** — A security-automation neighbor using a light canvas, pastel illustration washes and outlined product mockups; Tines keeps a sans body throughout.
- **Teenage Engineering** — Uppercase monospace labelling as product identity and a manual-like tone; Monad adds a bookish serif to carry the claims.
